senses.en: the activity of controlling a car or another road vehicle
strongly influencing something and making it happen
blown hard by strong winds

ex.en: Her careful driving made the mountain journey feel safe.
ex.zh: 她开车很谨慎，让这段山路旅程令人安心。

ex.en: Technological innovation is a driving force behind economic growth, although its benefits are not always shared equally.
ex.zh: 技术创新是经济增长的推动力，但其收益并不总能得到公平分享。

tip: driving force意为推动力；driving也可作drive的现在分词。
ety: drive 的字面意思是‘强行驱赶或推动向前’。

senses.en: A set of keys used to enter information into a computer

senses.zh: 乐器键盘；电子键盘乐器
senses.en: A musical instrument's keys, or an electronic instrument with keys

ex.en: I brushed the crumbs off my keyboard before starting work.
ex.zh: 开始工作前，我把键盘上的碎屑刷掉了。

ex.en: Students with limited mobility may benefit from an adapted keyboard that makes digital learning more accessible.
ex.zh: 行动不便的学生可能受益于经过改装的键盘，从而更方便地参与数字化学习。

col: play the keyboard｜弹电子键盘乐器
tip: 电脑键盘常说a keyboard；演奏键盘乐器用play the keyboard。
ety: key (键) + board (板) 的字面意思是‘装有许多小按键的板子’。

senses.en: a sliding storage compartment in a desk or other furniture

ex.en: I keep spare keys in the top kitchen drawer.
ex.zh: 我把备用钥匙放在厨房最上面的抽屉里。

ex.en: Office desks with lockable drawers help employees store personal belongings securely in shared working environments.
ex.zh: 配有可上锁抽屉的办公桌有助于员工在共享办公环境中安全存放私人物品。

tip: 抽屉是drawer；衣橱是wardrobe。
ety: draw 的字面意思是‘用来拉拽、抽出的东西。’

senses.en: an elastic material used to make tyres and other products
a small object used to remove pencil marks

ex.en: These rubber boots keep my feet dry in puddles.
ex.zh: 这双橡胶靴让我踩水坑时双脚也不会湿。

ex.en: Recycling rubber from used tyres can reduce waste and provide material for safer playground surfaces.
ex.zh: 回收废旧轮胎中的橡胶可以减少废物，并为更安全的游乐场地面提供材料。

tip: 橡胶不可数；橡皮擦可数，美式英语通常用eraser。
ety: [rub (v. 摩擦) + -er (名词后缀，表示物)]的字面意思是‘一个用来摩擦、擦拭的东西’。

senses.en: To combine different substances or things.
A combination of different substances, people, or things.
To spend time socially with other people.

ex.en: Mix the flour and eggs in a large bowl.
ex.zh: 把面粉和鸡蛋放进大碗里拌匀。

ex.en: Successful neighbourhoods often contain a mix of housing types that serve people with different incomes.
ex.zh: 成功的社区通常包含多种住房类型，以满足不同收入人群的需求。

col: a diverse mix｜多样化的组合
tip: mix A with B指混合；mix A up with B指混淆。
ety: 从词源看，拉丁语 miscere 的字面意思是‘将独立的物质搅动并汇聚在一起’。

senses.en: Energy carried by charged particles, used to power devices

ex.en: The storm cut off electricity to our entire street.
ex.zh: 暴风雨导致我们整条街停电了。

ex.en: Generating electricity from renewable sources can reduce dependence on fossil fuels and lower greenhouse gas emissions.
ex.zh: 利用可再生能源发电可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，并降低温室气体排放。

tip: electricity不可数；electric多指用电的，electrical指电相关的。
ety: 从词源看，electr- (琥珀) + -icity (名词后缀) 的字面意思是‘像摩擦琥珀后产生吸引力的那种神奇物理性质’。

senses.en: something made or grown to be sold or used
something that results from a process or situation
the result of multiplying two or more quantities

ex.en: This cleaning product removes stains from my kitchen tiles.
ex.zh: 这款清洁产品能去除我家厨房瓷砖上的污渍。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly prefer products that use less packaging and can be repaired rather than replaced.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越偏好包装更少、能够维修而不必更换的产品。

tip: product是产品或结果，production是生产过程。
ety: 从词源看，pro- (向前) + ducere (引导、拉)的字面意思是‘向前引导并带出的东西’。

senses.en: an African wild animal with black and white stripes

ex.en: A zebra stood quietly beside the watering hole.
ex.zh: 一匹斑马静静地站在水塘旁。

ex.en: Protecting grasslands helps zebra populations survive while preserving habitats for many other wild animals.
ex.zh: 保护草原有助于斑马种群生存，同时也为许多其他野生动物保留栖息地。

col: a herd of zebras｜一群斑马
tip: zebra crossing 是英式英语中的斑马线。
ety: 源自非洲班图语 的字面意思是‘一种身披黑白条纹的野生动物’。

senses.en: a liquid product used to wash hair
to wash hair using shampoo

ex.en: I packed a small bottle of shampoo for our trip.
ex.zh: 我为这次旅行装了一小瓶洗发水。

ex.en: Using refillable shampoo containers can reduce plastic waste generated by households and the tourism industry.
ex.zh: 使用可补充装的洗发水容器可以减少家庭和旅游业产生的塑料垃圾。

col: a bottle of shampoo｜一瓶洗发水
shampoo your hair｜用洗发水洗头
tip: 泛指洗发水通常不可数；一瓶用a bottle of shampoo。
ety: 借自印地语 champo 的字面意思是‘按压、揉捏’。

senses.en: A room or building equipped for scientific experiments and tests

ex.en: We wore safety goggles while mixing liquids in the lab.
ex.zh: 我们在实验室混合液体时戴着护目镜。

ex.en: A well-equipped school lab allows students to test scientific ideas through practical experiments rather than memorisation alone.
ex.zh: 设备齐全的学校实验室让学生通过实际实验检验科学观点，而非仅仅死记硬背。

tip: lab是laboratory的常用缩写，二者均为可数名词。
ety: 从词源看，laboratory（labor 劳作 +-atorium 地点后缀）的字面意思是‘进行劳作和工作的场所’，而 lab 是其现代口语中的截短形式。

senses.en: Feeling that something unexpected has happened.

ex.en: I was surprised to find flowers outside my door.
ex.zh: 发现门外放着鲜花，我很惊讶。

ex.en: Researchers were surprised by how strongly access to green spaces influenced residents' reported levels of wellbeing.
ex.zh: 绿地的可及性对居民自报幸福感的影响如此之大，令研究人员感到惊讶。

col: surprised at the result｜对结果感到惊讶
surprised to hear｜听到后感到意外
tip: surprised形容人的感受；surprising形容事物令人惊讶。
ety: 从词源看，sur- (在…之上) + prehendere (抓住) 的字面意思是‘从上方突然抓住’。

senses.en: a device that heats air, water, or another substance

ex.en: We switched on the heater before the guests arrived.
ex.zh: 客人到来前，我们打开了取暖器。

ex.en: Replacing an inefficient water heater can lower household energy bills and reduce overall electricity consumption.
ex.zh: 更换效率低下的热水器能降低家庭能源账单，并减少总体用电量。

tip: heater是设备；heating指供暖或供暖系统。
ety: heat + -er 的字面意思是“用于产生热量的器具”。

senses.en: Someone qualified to advise people about law and represent them.

ex.en: Our lawyer explained the contract before we signed it.
ex.zh: 我们的律师在我们签字前解释了合同内容。

ex.en: Access to an affordable lawyer helps ensure that everyone can defend their legal rights.
ex.zh: 能以可负担的费用聘请律师，有助于确保每个人都能维护自己的合法权利。

tip: lawyer是律师的统称，区别于法官judge。
ety: 从词源看，law (法律) + -yer (表人的后缀)的字面意思是‘精通并执掌法律的人’。

senses.en: a place where people buy goods
to keep something somewhere for future use
a supply of something kept for future use

ex.en: The store near our house sells fresh bread.
ex.zh: 我们家附近的商店卖新鲜面包。

ex.en: Modern batteries can store energy from solar panels for use when sunlight is no longer available.
ex.zh: 现代电池可以储存太阳能板产生的能量，以便在没有阳光时使用。

col: a store of knowledge｜知识储备
tip: 商店在美式中常用store，英式日常更常用shop。
ety: 从词源看，源自古法语 estorer 的 instaurare的拉丁语根，其字面意思是‘恢复、重建与筹备物资’。

senses.en: A round object that turns to move a vehicle.
The circular control used to steer a vehicle.
To move something along on its wheels.

ex.en: The front wheel of my bicycle needs replacing.
ex.zh: 我的自行车前轮需要更换。

ex.en: Transport planners should ensure that passengers can wheel their luggage easily through stations and onto trains.
ex.zh: 交通规划者应确保乘客能轻松推着行李穿过车站并登上列车。

tip: at或behind the wheel常表示正在开车。
ety: 从词源看，原始印欧语重叠词根 *kʷekʷlo-的字面意思是‘反复转动之物’。

senses.en: A single object, especially one in a collection.
One part of a list, programme, or news report.

ex.en: Please place each item carefully in the shopping bag.
ex.zh: 请把每件商品小心地放进购物袋。

ex.en: Each item on the meeting agenda addresses a different challenge facing local public transport services.
ex.zh: 会议议程中的每一项都涉及当地公共交通服务面临的不同挑战。

tip: item是可数名词；一件衣物可说an item of clothing。
ety: 从词源看，拉丁语副词 item (同样地，又) 的字面意思是‘在账目清单中另起一行记录的同样性质的事项’。

senses.en: Someone who welcomes visitors and handles enquiries at a reception desk.

ex.en: The receptionist smiled and handed us our room keys.
ex.zh: 接待员微笑着把房间钥匙递给了我们。

ex.en: A skilled receptionist can improve patients' experiences by managing appointments efficiently and responding calmly to enquiries.
ex.zh: 熟练的接待员能够高效安排预约、沉着回应咨询，从而改善患者的就诊体验。

col: work as a receptionist｜担任接待员
tip: reception 是接待处；receptionist 是接待员。
ety: reception [接纳、迎接] + -ist [……的人]的字面意思是‘专门负责将外界人事物接收并迎进来的人’。

senses.en: A man whose job is to sell goods or services.

ex.en: The salesman showed us how to fold the bicycle.
ex.zh: 那位男销售员向我们演示了如何折叠自行车。

ex.en: A skilled salesman should explain product limitations honestly rather than pressure customers into making unnecessary purchases.
ex.zh: 有技巧的销售员应如实解释产品的局限，而不是强迫顾客购买不必要的东西。

col: an experienced salesman｜经验丰富的销售员
tip: salesman明确指男性；不强调性别时用salesperson。
ety: sale (销售) + man (人) 的字面意思是‘专门负责从事售卖、交易活动的人’。

senses.en: extremely good or enjoyable
strange and imaginative, rather than realistic
extremely large in amount or degree

ex.en: We had a fantastic view of the mountains from our balcony.
ex.zh: 从阳台望去，山景美极了。

ex.en: Community sports programmes offer young people a fantastic opportunity to develop teamwork skills and build confidence.
ex.zh: 社区体育项目为年轻人提供了培养团队合作技能和增强自信的绝佳机会。

tip: 表示“极好的”偏口语；正式写作可用excellent。
ety: 希腊语 phantastikos 的字面意思是‘由想象力显现出来的影像’。

senses.en: the activity or sport of moving quickly on foot
the work of managing or operating something
flowing continuously or operating rather than stopped

ex.en: Running along the beach always clears my head.
ex.zh: 沿着海滩跑步总能让我头脑清醒。

ex.en: Local volunteers play a crucial role in the daily running of community sports centres.
ex.zh: 当地志愿者在社区体育中心的日常管理中发挥着关键作用。

tip: 表示跑步活动时不可数；the running of指管理。
ety: 源自动词 run 加上后缀 -ing 的字面意思是‘保持快速移动或流淌的状态’。

senses.en: A movable barrier controlling entry through a fence or wall.
An airport area where passengers board a plane.

ex.en: She closed the garden gate to keep the dog inside.
ex.zh: 她关上花园的门，免得狗跑出去。

ex.en: Airports should provide clear directions so passengers can reach their departure gate without unnecessary stress.
ex.zh: 机场应提供清晰的指引，让乘客无需过度紧张就能找到登机口。

tip: gate多指围墙或栅栏上的门；房间的门通常用door。
ety: 从词源看，古诺斯语 gata 的字面意思是‘道路或开口’。

senses.en: the name given to a book, film, or other work
a name indicating someone's rank, position, or professional role
the position of winner in a sporting competition

ex.en: I remember the book's cover but not its title.
ex.zh: 我记得这本书的封面，却不记得书名了。

ex.en: An effective essay title should clearly indicate the main issue being discussed without revealing every detail.
ex.zh: 好的文章标题应清楚表明所讨论的主要问题，而不必透露所有细节。

tip: title是标题或名称；topic是讨论的主题。
ety: 从词源看，titulus 的字面意思是‘标明身份或所有权的标牌’。

senses.en: The area beside railway tracks where passengers board trains.
A raised surface where people can stand or perform.
A service or system for sharing information or doing activities.

ex.en: We waited on the platform as the train approached.
ex.zh: 火车驶近时，我们正在站台上等候。

ex.en: Online learning platforms allow students in remote areas to access courses that are unavailable locally.
ex.zh: 在线学习平台让偏远地区的学生能够学习当地没有开设的课程。

col: a platform for debate｜辩论的平台
tip: 在站台上用on the platform，不用in。
ety: 从词源看，plat (平坦的) + form (形状) 的字面意思是‘一个平坦的形状或表面’。

senses.en: The act of leaving a vehicle in a particular place.
Space or facilities where vehicles can be left.

ex.en: Parking is difficult on this narrow street after sunset.
ex.zh: 日落后，在这条狭窄的街道上停车很困难。

ex.en: Reducing free parking in city centres may encourage commuters to use public transport more frequently.
ex.zh: 减少市中心的免费停车位可能促使通勤者更频繁地使用公共交通。

tip: 名词通常不可数；一个停车位说a parking space。
ety: 从词源看，park + -ing 的字面意思是‘将物体安置在围栏或指定区域内的动作’。

senses.en: To take something's place or put something else in its place.
To put something back where it was before.

ex.en: We need to replace the broken kitchen chair.
ex.zh: 我们需要换掉厨房里那把坏椅子。

ex.en: Renewable energy could gradually replace fossil fuels if governments invest sufficiently in infrastructure and storage technology.
ex.zh: 如果政府充分投资基础设施和储能技术，可再生能源就可能逐步取代化石燃料。

tip: replace A with B是用B换掉A，别弄反方向。
ety: 从词源看，re- (重新) + place (放置) 的字面意思是‘重新放回或安置在某个位置’。

senses.en: An outdoor area beside a building, often enclosed.
A unit of length equal to three feet or 0.9144 metres.

ex.en: Our dog chased a yellow ball across the yard.
ex.zh: 我们的狗追着一个黄色的球跑过院子。

ex.en: Converting an unused school yard into a garden can provide valuable outdoor learning opportunities for urban children.
ex.zh: 把闲置的校园庭院改成花园，可以为城市儿童提供宝贵的户外学习机会。

col: a yard of fabric｜一码布料
tip: 美式yard可指住宅草坪庭院；英式多用garden。
ety: 从词源看，古英语 gierd/geard 的字面意思是‘围起来的土地或测量用的木杆’。

senses.en: a machine that produces paper copies of digital documents or images
a person or business that prints books and other materials

ex.en: The printer ran out of paper halfway through my homework.
ex.zh: 我的作业打印到一半时，打印机没纸了。

ex.en: Schools can reduce paper waste by setting every printer to print on both sides automatically.
ex.zh: 学校可以将所有打印机设为自动双面打印，从而减少纸张浪费。

tip: print是打印；printer可指机器，也可指印刷从业者。
ety: print (压印、印刷) + -er (表名词后缀，指人或物) 的字面意思是‘执行压印动作的机器或执行印刷任务的人’。

senses.en: Earth's solid surface, or an area used for a particular purpose.
To reach the ground, or bring an aircraft to the ground.
To succeed in getting something desirable, especially a job.

ex.en: After hours at sea, we finally spotted dry land.
ex.zh: 在海上航行数小时后，我们终于看到了陆地。

ex.en: Protecting agricultural land from urban expansion is essential for maintaining food production near growing cities.
ex.zh: 保护农业用地免受城市扩张侵占，对维持发展中城市周边的粮食生产至关重要。

col: land a job｜成功找到工作
tip: 表示土地通常不可数；land a job指成功获得工作。
ety: 从词源看，原始日耳曼语词根 *landam 的字面意思是‘地球表面坚实、可供人类踏足与定居的固体区域’。

senses.en: A man who works in business, especially managing a company.

ex.en: A local businessman opened a bakery near our school.
ex.zh: 一位当地商人在我们学校附近开了一家面包店。

ex.en: A successful businessman can support local development by investing in training and creating stable employment opportunities.
ex.zh: 成功的商人可以通过投资培训和创造稳定就业机会来支持当地发展。

tip: 复数为businessmen；不限定性别可用businessperson。
ety: business (商业、事务) + man (男人) 的字面意思是‘从事商业事务的男人’。

senses.en: Feeling happy or pleased about something.
Willing and pleased to do something.

ex.en: I'm glad you came to dinner with us tonight.
ex.zh: 我很高兴你今晚来和我们一起吃饭。

ex.en: Many residents were glad that the council had decided to preserve the local park.
ex.zh: 许多居民都很高兴，地方议会决定保留当地的公园。

tip: 常作表语；用be glad to do或be glad that从句。
ety: 从词源看，古英语 glæd 的字面意思是‘明亮闪耀的光芒’。

senses.en: To give out or reflect light.
To polish something until its surface becomes bright and smooth.
Brightness on a smooth surface that reflects light.

ex.en: The sun shone through my bedroom window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，阳光透过我卧室的窗户照了进来。

ex.en: Streetlights that shine directly into homes can disturb sleep and reduce residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 直接照进住宅的路灯会干扰睡眠，降低居民的生活质量。

col: shine a light on｜用灯照向
tip: 发光的过去式常用shone；擦亮的过去式用shined。
ety: 古英语词源 scīnan 的字面意思是‘发出明亮的光辉’。

senses.en: A sweet, juicy fruit, often narrower at the top

ex.en: She sliced a ripe pear into her breakfast bowl.
ex.zh: 她把一个熟梨切成片，放进早餐碗里。

ex.en: Buying locally grown pears during their natural season may reduce the need for long-distance food transport.
ex.zh: 在自然成熟的季节购买本地种植的梨，可能减少长途食品运输的需求。

tip: pear与pair同音；一个梨用a pear。
ety: 古英语 pera 的字面意思是‘梨这种特定的果实’。

senses.en: A day when you do not have to work.

ex.en: On my day off, I cycled to the lake.
ex.zh: 休息那天，我骑车去了湖边。

ex.en: Taking a regular day off allows employees to recover and may improve their performance at work.
ex.zh: 定期休息一天能让员工恢复精力，也可能提高工作表现。

col: take a day off｜休息一天
have a day off｜有一天休假
a day off work｜一天不上班
tip: 复数是days off；请一天假可说take a day off。

senses.en: Entertainment intended to make people laugh.
The humorous quality of a situation or event.

ex.en: We watched a comedy and laughed all evening.
ex.zh: 我们看了一部喜剧，整个晚上都笑个不停。

ex.en: Comedy can encourage audiences to question social attitudes by presenting familiar problems in unexpected and amusing ways.
ex.zh: 喜剧可以用出人意料又有趣的方式呈现常见问题，促使观众反思社会观念。

tip: 指喜剧类型时通常不可数；一部喜剧用a comedy。
ety: 古希腊语 kōmōidia (kōmos 狂欢 + aeidein歌唱) 的字面意思是“在村社狂欢游行中唱歌跳舞、嬉闹庆祝的场面”。

senses.en: without waiting or any delay
directly before, after, or next to something
as soon as something happens

ex.en: When the doorbell rang, I immediately opened the door.
ex.zh: 门铃一响，我就立刻打开了门。

ex.en: Schools should respond immediately to safety concerns rather than waiting for a serious incident to occur.
ex.zh: 学校应立即回应安全方面的担忧，而不是等到严重事件发生才采取行动。

tip: 作连词表示“一……就”主要见于英式英语。
ety: 从词源看，im- (无) + mediatus (中间环节)的字面意思是‘没有中间环节、没有间隔’。

senses.en: an appliance or compartment that keeps food frozen

ex.en: Put the ice cream back in the freezer.
ex.zh: 把冰激凌放回冷冻室。

ex.en: Using a freezer allows households to store seasonal produce longer and reduce food waste.
ex.zh: 使用冷冻柜能让家庭更长时间地储存时令农产品，减少食物浪费。

col: defrost the freezer｜给冷冻柜除霜
tip: freezer用于冷冻；fridge主要用于冷藏。
ety: freeze (冻结) + -er (表物后缀) 的字面意思是“用于使某物结冰的器具”。

senses.en: A bag carried on your back using shoulder straps.

ex.en: I packed my lunch and jacket in a rucksack.
ex.zh: 我把午餐和夹克装进了双肩背包。

ex.en: Travellers carrying only a rucksack can move more easily between public transport services.
ex.zh: 只背一个双肩包的旅行者换乘公共交通时行动更方便。

tip: 英式英语常用rucksack；不限定帆布材质。

senses.en: A short piece of writing exploring a particular subject.

ex.en: I finished my history essay just before dinner.
ex.zh: 我刚好在晚饭前写完了历史课论文。

ex.en: Writing an essay encourages students to organise their ideas and support arguments with relevant evidence.
ex.zh: 撰写论说文能促使学生整理思路，并用相关证据支持论点。

col: an essay on｜一篇关于……的文章
tip: 可数名词；一篇关于某主题的文章用an essay on。
ety: 从词源看，拉丁语 exagium 的字面意思是‘称量、权衡’。

senses.en: A place serving alcoholic drinks and often meals, especially in Britain.

ex.en: We had vegetable soup at the village pub.
ex.zh: 我们在村里的酒馆喝了蔬菜汤。

ex.en: In some rural communities, the local pub provides an important meeting place for residents.
ex.zh: 在一些乡村社区，当地酒馆为居民提供了重要的聚会场所。

tip: pub多见于英国语境，常供应餐食，不等于旅馆。
ety: [public house 的缩略形式] 的字面意思是‘供公众聚集的房屋’。

senses.en: A child or young person, in informal language.
Say something playfully that is not meant to be believed.
A young goat.

ex.en: The kids built a tiny bridge across the stream.
ex.zh: 孩子们在小溪上搭了一座小桥。

ex.en: Outdoor activities can help kids develop social skills while improving their physical health.
ex.zh: 户外活动可以帮助孩子们发展社交技能，同时改善身体健康。

tip: kid较口语；正式作文中“孩子”宜用child。
ety: 从词源看，古诺斯语 kið 的字面意思是‘小山羊’。

senses.en: To succeed in doing something, especially something difficult.
To direct or control a business, team, or activity.
To cope with a situation despite difficulties or limited resources.

ex.en: I managed to carry all the bags upstairs.
ex.zh: 我总算把所有袋子都提上了楼。

ex.en: Many students manage to balance academic demands with paid employment by planning their weekly schedules carefully.
ex.zh: 许多学生通过仔细安排每周日程，设法兼顾学业要求与有薪工作。

col: manage to do something｜设法做成某事
tip: manage to do表示成功做成，不只是尝试。
ety: 从词源看，manus (手) 与 agere (做) 的组合的字面意思是‘用手去驾驭和操控’。

senses.en: A group or show featuring acrobats, clowns, and other performers.

ex.en: We watched the circus performers juggle brightly coloured balls.
ex.zh: 我们看着马戏演员抛接色彩鲜艳的球。

ex.en: Modern circus performances can preserve traditional entertainment skills while creating opportunities for artists from diverse backgrounds.
ex.zh: 现代马戏表演既能保留传统娱乐技艺，也能为不同背景的艺术工作者创造机会。

tip: 可指马戏团或表演；复数为circuses。
ety: 源自拉丁语 circus 的字面意思是‘一个封闭的圆环形场地或竞技场。’

senses.en: Someone who visits places for pleasure rather than work

ex.en: A tourist asked me how to reach the castle.
ex.zh: 一位游客问我怎么去城堡。

ex.en: Large numbers of tourists support local businesses but can also place pressure on public transport.
ex.zh: 大量游客为当地企业带来生意，但也可能给公共交通造成压力。

tip: tourist通常是名词，在tourist attraction中修饰名词。
ety: 从词源看，tour + -ist 的字面意思是‘一个进行环游、兜圈子旅行的人’。

senses.en: A tool with pointed prongs for picking up food
A place where a road or path divides
Divide into separate branches or directions

ex.en: She picked up a carrot with her fork.
ex.zh: 她用餐叉叉起了一块胡萝卜。

ex.en: Where a rural path forks, clear directions can prevent visitors from entering environmentally sensitive areas.
ex.zh: 在乡间小路分叉处提供清晰指引，可以防止游客进入生态敏感区域。

col: a knife and fork｜一副刀叉
a fork in the road｜道路岔口
tip: 道路forks表示分叉；a fork in the road指岔路口。
ety: 古英语 forca (源自拉丁语 furca) 的字面意思是‘用来叉起干草的两齿工具’。

senses.en: Use more of something than necessary or without useful results.
Unwanted material left after something has been used or made.
An unnecessary or unproductive use of time, money, or resources.

ex.en: Don't waste water by leaving the tap running.
ex.zh: 别让水龙头一直开着，白白浪费水。

ex.en: Reducing household waste requires both convenient recycling facilities and greater public awareness of responsible consumption.
ex.zh: 减少生活垃圾既需要便利的回收设施，也需要提高公众的负责任消费意识。

col: a waste of money｜浪费金钱
tip: 用waste time doing sth，通常不用to do。
ety: 从词源看，源自古法语 wast 和拉丁语 vastus的字面意思是‘一片空无、荒凉的土地’。

senses.en: the head of state in a country without a monarch
the person leading an organisation, company, club, or university

ex.en: The president waved to the crowd outside the palace.
ex.zh: 总统向宫殿外的人群挥手致意。

ex.en: The newly elected president promised to improve public healthcare and expand access to affordable education.
ex.zh: 新当选的总统承诺改善公共医疗，并扩大可负担教育的覆盖范围。

tip: 可指总统，也可指机构负责人；具体译法看语境。
ety: 从词源看，prae- (在…前面) + sedere (坐)的字面意思是‘坐在前面的人’。

senses.en: Someone who cuts men's hair and trims or shaves beards.

ex.en: The barber trimmed my hair before the wedding.
ex.zh: 婚礼前，理发师给我修剪了头发。

ex.en: Local businesses, such as a neighbourhood barber, provide essential services and create opportunities for informal social interaction.
ex.zh: 社区理发师等本地商家提供基本服务，也为非正式社交创造机会。

col: go to the barber's｜去理发店
tip: barber主要为男士理发修面；barber's可指理发店。
ety: [barba (胡须) + -er (人)] 的字面意思是‘与胡须打交道的人’。

senses.en: Sleeping rather than awake.

ex.en: The baby was asleep before we reached home.
ex.zh: 我们还没到家，宝宝就睡着了。

ex.en: People who use electronic devices late at night may find it harder to fall asleep.
ex.zh: 深夜使用电子设备的人可能更难入睡。

tip: asleep通常作表语；“熟睡的婴儿”用a sleeping baby。
ety: a- (处于……状态) + sleep (睡眠) 的字面意思是‘处于睡眠的静止状态中’。

senses.en: Someone who gathers and presents news for the public.

ex.en: A reporter interviewed the coach after the match.
ex.zh: 比赛结束后，一名记者采访了教练。

ex.en: A responsible reporter checks information carefully before publishing stories that could influence public opinion on important social issues.
ex.zh: 负责任的记者在发表可能影响公众对重要社会问题看法的报道之前，会仔细核实信息。

tip: reporter侧重新闻采访报道；journalist涵盖范围更广。
ety: 从词源看，re- (回) + portare (携带) + -er(……者) 的字面意思是‘把信息从现场带回来的人’。

senses.en: A female monarch, or the wife of a king.
The main egg-laying female in a social insect colony.
The chess piece that moves any distance in any direction.

ex.en: The queen waved to the crowd from her carriage.
ex.zh: 女王从马车里向人群挥手。

ex.en: In some constitutional monarchies, the queen performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
ex.zh: 在一些君主立宪制国家，女王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。

tip: queen 可指统治国家的女王，也可指国王的妻子。
ety: 源自古英语 cwen 的字面意思是‘一个拥有崇高地位的成年女性或母亲。’

senses.en: The work of helping people learn knowledge or skills.
Ideas or principles taught by a person or tradition.

ex.en: Her love of teaching began at a small village school.
ex.zh: 她对教学的热爱始于一所小乡村学校。

ex.en: Effective teaching should combine clear explanations with practical activities that encourage students to apply their knowledge independently.
ex.zh: 有效的教学应将清晰的讲解与实践活动结合起来，鼓励学生独立运用知识。

col: a career in teaching｜教师职业生涯
tip: 指教学时不可数；指教义或学说常用teachings。
ety: 从词源看，teach + -ing 的字面意思是‘展示、指出并传授的行为’。

senses.en: the science of matter, energy, forces, and their interactions

ex.en: Our physics teacher showed us how magnets attract iron.
ex.zh: 我们的物理老师演示了磁铁如何吸引铁。

ex.en: A strong understanding of physics can help engineers develop safer buildings and more efficient transport systems.
ex.zh: 扎实的物理学知识能帮助工程师设计更安全的建筑和更高效的交通系统。

col: the laws of physics｜物理定律
tip: 虽以s结尾，仍作不可数名词，谓语用单数。
ety: phys- (自然、身体) + -ics (学科后缀) 的字面意思是‘关于自然界本质的学问’。

senses.en: The process of paying and leaving a hotel
The latest time guests must leave their hotel rooms

ex.en: We left our bags at reception after check-out.
ex.zh: 退房后，我们把行李留在了前台。

ex.en: Flexible check-out times can improve the travel experience for families with young children.
ex.zh: 灵活的退房时间可以改善带幼儿出行家庭的旅行体验。

tip: 名词也写作checkout；动词用check out。

senses.en: to grow or make something stronger, larger, or more advanced
to create a new product, method, or idea
to begin to have a condition, problem, or feeling

ex.en: Children develop confidence when they try new activities.
ex.zh: 孩子们尝试新活动时会逐渐建立自信。

ex.en: Governments should fund research to develop affordable technologies that address water shortages in rural communities.
ex.zh: 政府应资助研究，开发价格可负担的技术，以解决农村社区的缺水问题。

tip: 可及物也可不及物：develop skills；skills develop。
ety: 从词源看，dis-（去除包裹）+ envelop（包裹）的字面意思是‘解开包裹，使内部之物显露’。

senses.en: Running slowly and steadily as a form of exercise.

ex.en: She goes jogging around the park before breakfast.
ex.zh: 她早饭前会绕着公园慢跑。

ex.en: Regular jogging can improve physical fitness, especially when combined with a balanced diet and adequate rest.
ex.zh: 经常慢跑可以改善体能，尤其是在配合均衡饮食和充足休息的情况下。

tip: jog变为jogging时须双写g。
ety: jog 的字面意思是‘带着轻微颠簸和节奏感的晃动前行’。

senses.en: Make someone or something ready for an activity or situation
Make food, a document, or a plan ready for use

ex.en: I prepare my lunch before leaving home each morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早上出门前都会准备好午餐。

ex.en: Schools should prepare students for employment by developing practical skills alongside their academic knowledge.
ex.zh: 学校应在传授学术知识的同时培养实用技能，让学生为就业做好准备。

col: prepare for an exam｜准备考试
tip: prepare for后接名词；prepare to后接动词原形。
ety: 从词源看，prae- (在前) + parare (使停妥)的字面意思是‘在事件发生之前，把一切摆放妥当、安排停当’。

senses.en: Relating to Switzerland, its people, or their culture.
The people of Switzerland, considered as a group.

ex.en: We enjoyed Swiss cheese during our picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖边野餐时品尝了瑞士奶酪。

ex.en: Swiss railways demonstrate how reliable public transport can connect remote mountain communities and support sustainable tourism.
ex.zh: 瑞士铁路展示了可靠的公共交通如何连接偏远山区社区并支持可持续旅游。

tip: 首字母须大写；the Swiss统称瑞士人，不加s。
ety: 源自阿勒曼尼语 Schwiizer 的字面意思是‘施维茨（瑞士奠基州）的居民’。

senses.en: a large cup with a handle, usually for hot drinks
to attack someone in public and steal from them

ex.en: I warmed my hands around a mug of tea.
ex.zh: 我双手捧着一大杯茶取暖。

ex.en: Providing reusable mugs in offices can reduce the waste generated by disposable cups each day.
ex.zh: 在办公室提供可重复使用的杯子，可以减少每天由一次性杯子产生的垃圾。

col: a mug of coffee｜一大杯咖啡
tip: mug通常有柄、较大；作动词可指拦路抢劫。
ety: 源自古斯堪的纳维亚语 的字面意思是‘大罐子或人的面孔’。

senses.en: Tiny loose grains of rock found on beaches and in deserts.
To make a surface smooth by rubbing it with sandpaper.

ex.en: The children built a castle from wet sand.
ex.zh: 孩子们用湿沙堆了一座城堡。

ex.en: Removing sand from riverbeds for construction can damage habitats and increase the risk of erosion.
ex.zh: 为建筑工程开采河床中的沙子可能破坏栖息地，并增加侵蚀风险。

tip: 表示沙子时不可数；一粒沙用a grain of sand。
ety: 从词源看，古日耳曼语 *samdaz 的字面意思是‘岩石风化后形成的细小颗粒’。

senses.en: A coat that keeps your clothes dry in the rain.

ex.en: I grabbed my raincoat before stepping into the rain.
ex.zh: 走进雨中之前，我一把拿起了雨衣。

ex.en: Travellers visiting regions with unpredictable weather should carry a lightweight raincoat to stay comfortable during outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 前往天气多变地区的旅行者应携带轻便雨衣，以便在户外活动时保持舒适。

col: put on a raincoat｜穿上雨衣
tip: 英美英语都使用raincoat，并非仅限美式。
ety: [rain (雨) + coat (外套)] 的字面意思是‘用于挡雨的外套’。

senses.en: A book containing personal accounts of daily events and feelings.
A book used to record appointments and future plans.

ex.en: I write in my diary before going to bed.
ex.zh: 我睡前会写日记。

ex.en: Keeping a learning diary encourages students to reflect on their progress and identify difficulties.
ex.zh: 坚持写学习日记能鼓励学生反思自己的进步并发现困难。

tip: diary是日记，dairy是乳制品；注意字母顺序。
ety: 源自拉丁语 diurnus (每日的) 的字面意思是‘记录每一天发生的事情的册子’。

senses.en: A motor vehicle with two wheels, usually for one or two.
To travel by motorcycle.

ex.en: He parked his motorcycle beside the garden gate.
ex.zh: 他把摩托车停在花园门旁。

ex.en: Although motorcycles require less parking space than cars, riders are more exposed to injury in road accidents.
ex.zh: 尽管摩托车所需的停车空间比汽车小，骑手在交通事故中却更容易受伤。

tip: 骑摩托车用ride，通常不用drive。
ety: motor (发动机) + cycle (轮子) 的字面意思是‘装有发动机的轮子车辆’。

senses.en: to keep something in your hands or arms
to organise an event or meeting
to have enough space for something or someone

ex.en: Could you hold my bag while I tie my shoes?
ex.zh: 我系鞋带时，你能帮我拿一下包吗？

ex.en: Local councils should hold public meetings before making major changes to transport services.
ex.zh: 地方议会在对交通服务作出重大调整之前，应当召开公众会议。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为held；举行会议用hold。
ety: 从词源看，古英语 haldan 的字面意思是‘紧紧看守并护住某物’。

senses.en: the area where visitors are welcomed and given information
a formal social event held to welcome or celebrate someone
how well signals are received, or how people respond

ex.en: Please leave your room key at reception before breakfast.
ex.zh: 请在早餐前把房间钥匙留在前台。

ex.en: The proposal received a positive reception from local residents because it addressed their concerns about road safety.
ex.zh: 这项提议回应了当地居民对道路安全的担忧，因此获得了积极反响。

tip: 英式英语常说at reception，表示在接待处。
ety: re- (回/向内) + capere (拿/取) 的字面意思是‘将外部的东西拿进来或收容’。

senses.en: From or relating to a country other than your own.
Present where it does not naturally belong.
Unfamiliar to someone or inconsistent with something.

ex.en: My sister enjoys learning foreign languages in her spare time.
ex.zh: 我姐姐喜欢在空闲时间学习外语。

ex.en: Foreign investment can create jobs, but governments should ensure that local communities also benefit from economic growth.
ex.zh: 外国投资可以创造就业机会，但政府应确保当地社区也能从经济增长中受益。

tip: foreign to可指对某人陌生，或与某事不相符。
ety: 严格按照“从词源看，古法语 forain (在外面)及拉丁语 foris (门) 的字面意思是‘站在大门之外的’。”这样的句式，把 root_breakdown和 literal_image 组织成一句完整、简洁的中文话术，作为速写小结，不展开完整历史故事

senses.en: the planet where humans and other known living things exist
the loose material on the ground in which plants grow

ex.en: The children dug into the damp earth with small spades.
ex.zh: 孩子们用小铲子挖开湿润的泥土。

ex.en: Life on earth depends on healthy ecosystems that provide clean water, food, and breathable air.
ex.zh: 地球上的生命依赖于能够提供洁净水源、食物和可呼吸空气的健康生态系统。

tip: 指行星时常写Earth；on earth中不加the。
ety: 从词源看，源自原始印欧语 *er-（地面、土壤）及古英语 eorþe 的字面意思是‘踩在脚下的泥土与大地’。

senses.en: A small container or wrapped quantity of something.
A small unit of data transmitted across a network.

ex.en: She opened a packet of biscuits for the journey.
ex.zh: 她打开了一包饼干，准备在路上吃。

ex.en: Charging customers for each packet of disposable utensils could encourage more sustainable habits in the food industry.
ex.zh: 对每包一次性餐具收费，可以推动餐饮行业形成更可持续的习惯。

col: a packet of biscuits｜一包饼干
tip: 英式常用a packet of；美式常依物品用pack或bag。
ety: pack (包裹、捆扎) + -et (名词后缀，表微小)的字面意思是‘一个小型的包裹或捆扎物’。

senses.en: A narrow board with small wheels, ridden standing up.
To move or perform tricks on a skateboard.

ex.en: He carried his skateboard home when the rain started.
ex.zh: 开始下雨时，他抱着滑板回家了。

ex.en: Providing dedicated areas for skateboard users can encourage physical activity while reducing conflicts with pedestrians in public spaces.
ex.zh: 为滑板使用者提供专用区域，可以鼓励体育活动，同时减少公共空间中与行人的冲突。

tip: skateboard无扶手；scooter通常有扶手。
ety: skate (冰鞋/滑冰) + board (木板) 的字面意思是‘装有轮子、在地面上滑行的木板’。

senses.en: a wide road designed for fast travel over long distances

ex.en: We left the motorway and stopped for lunch.
ex.zh: 我们驶离高速公路，停下来吃午饭。

ex.en: Building a new motorway may reduce journey times, but it can also damage nearby wildlife habitats.
ex.zh: 修建新的高速公路可能缩短行程时间，但也会破坏附近的野生动物栖息地。

col: join the motorway｜驶入高速公路
tip: 主要用于英式英语；美式常用freeway。

senses.en: Relating to Europe or its people.
A person from Europe.

ex.en: We explored several European cities during our summer holiday.
ex.zh: 暑假期间，我们游览了几座欧洲城市。

ex.en: Many European countries have invested in railway networks to reduce dependence on short domestic flights.
ex.zh: 许多欧洲国家投资建设铁路网，以减少对短途国内航班的依赖。

tip: 首字母大写；前用a而非an，不等同于欧盟的。
ety: 从词源看，Europa + -an 的字面意思是‘属于神话中欧罗芭公主所代表的那片广袤大地的’。

senses.en: an unpleasant physical feeling caused by injury or illness
strong emotional suffering caused by loss or distress
to cause someone emotional suffering

ex.en: I felt a sharp pain in my left ankle.
ex.zh: 我的左脚踝感到一阵剧痛。

ex.en: Regular exercise may reduce back pain among office workers who remain seated for long periods.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼可能减轻长时间久坐的办公室职员的背痛。

tip: 泛指疼痛常不可数；具体一阵疼痛可用a pain。
ety: 从词源看，poena 的字面意思是‘为过失支付的代价与惩罚’。

senses.en: certainly, with no doubt about something

ex.en: I will definitely bring an umbrella after yesterday's rain.
ex.zh: 昨天下过雨后，我今天肯定会带伞。

ex.en: Improved insulation will definitely reduce heat loss, although total energy savings depend on household behaviour.
ex.zh: 改善隔热性能肯定能减少热量流失，不过总节能量取决于住户的行为。

tip: 拼写是definitely；不要与defiantly混淆。
ety: [de- (完全) + finis (界限) + -ite + -ly]的字面意思是‘被彻底划定了明确边界的样子’。

senses.en: A unit of distance equal to approximately 1.61 kilometres.

ex.en: The nearest swimming pool is only a mile away.
ex.zh: 最近的游泳池只有一英里远。

ex.en: Replacing short car journeys with walking even one mile could improve public health and reduce emissions.
ex.zh: 用步行替代短途驾车，哪怕只走一英里，也能改善公众健康并减少排放。

tip: 英里是距离单位；mile可数，复数加s。

senses.en: Having a lot of wind.

ex.en: It was too windy to eat lunch outside today.
ex.zh: 今天风太大，没法在外面吃午饭。

ex.en: Windy coastal regions can generate renewable electricity, although turbines must be positioned carefully to protect wildlife.
ex.zh: 多风的沿海地区可以生产可再生电力，但风力涡轮机必须谨慎选址，以保护野生动物。

col: a windy day｜刮大风的一天
tip: 天气义读/ˈwɪndi/；描述道路蜿蜒通常用winding。
ety: wind + -y 的字面意思是“充满风的、被风吹拂的”。

senses.en: in or to a place that is not specified
approximately, when used before an amount or range

ex.en: I left my keys somewhere near the sofa.
ex.zh: 我把钥匙落在沙发附近的某个地方了。

ex.en: Young people need somewhere affordable to live before they can fully participate in the local economy.
ex.zh: 年轻人需要有负担得起的住所，才能充分参与当地的经济活动。

tip: 形容词放后面：somewhere quiet；前面通常不加to。
ety: 从词源看，some + where 的字面意思是‘某个地方’。

senses.en: A device or application used for mathematical calculations

ex.en: I used a calculator to check the shopping total.
ex.zh: 我用计算器核对了购物总额。

ex.en: Allowing students to use a calculator can help them focus on solving more complex mathematical problems.
ex.zh: 允许学生使用计算器，可以帮助他们专注于解决更复杂的数学问题。

tip: calculator指工具；calculation指计算过程或结果。
ety: [calculus (小石头，计数用的石子) + -ator (表示人或物)] 的字面意思是‘用小石子进行计数或算账的工具或人’。

senses.en: the natural object that moves around Earth
a natural object that moves around a planet

ex.en: The moon rose slowly above the trees behind our house.
ex.zh: 月亮在我们屋后的树梢上缓缓升起。

ex.en: Research on the moon may help scientists understand how Earth and other rocky planets formed.
ex.zh: 对月球的研究可能帮助科学家了解地球和其他岩石行星的形成过程。

col: the surface of the moon｜月球表面
tip: 指地球的月亮通常用the moon；其他行星的卫星可数。
ety: 从词源看，源自原始印欧语 *mēnsō-（意为‘测量’）的字面意思是‘作为时间测量尺度的夜空发光天体’。

senses.en: of the kind already mentioned or being described
used to emphasise a quality or degree before a noun

ex.en: It was such a lovely day that we ate outside.
ex.zh: 天气如此宜人，我们就在外面吃了饭。

ex.en: Many cities face severe traffic congestion, and such problems require coordinated investment in public transport.
ex.zh: 许多城市面临严重的交通拥堵，这类问题需要统筹公共交通投资来解决。

tip: 单数可数名词前用such a/an；so后直接接形容词。
ety: 从词源看，swā (如此) + lic (相似的) 的字面意思是‘如此这般相似的，长相与前文如出一辙的’。

senses.en: To defeat someone in a game, competition, or contest.
To hit repeatedly, or move with a regular rhythm.
A regular pulse of sound or movement.

ex.en: My sister beat me at chess again yesterday.
ex.zh: 我姐姐昨天又下棋赢了我。

ex.en: Athletes need consistent training and psychological support to beat their strongest competitors in international events.
ex.zh: 运动员需要持续训练和心理支持，才能在国际赛事中击败最强劲的对手。

tip: 过去式 beat，过去分词 beaten；赢比赛用 win。
ety: 从词源看，古英语 bēatan 的字面意思是‘反复进行打击、敲击’。

senses.en: a liquid fuel used in cars and other engines

ex.en: We stopped for petrol before driving into the mountains.
ex.zh: 开车进山前，我们停车加了汽油。

ex.en: Higher petrol prices may encourage commuters to use public transport rather than drive to work.
ex.zh: 汽油价格上涨可能促使通勤者乘坐公共交通，而不是开车上班。

col: run out of petrol｜汽油用尽
tip: 不可数名词；英式用petrol，美式用gasoline或gas。

senses.en: A fixed regular payment for work, often expressed yearly

ex.en: Her new job offers a higher salary and shorter hours.
ex.zh: 她的新工作薪水更高，工时也更短。

ex.en: Although salary influences career choices, many graduates also value job security and opportunities for professional development.
ex.zh: 虽然薪水会影响职业选择，但许多毕业生也重视工作保障和职业发展机会。

tip: salary指固定薪金；wages常指按时或按周计算的工资。
ety: 从词源看，sal (盐) + -arium (表示场所或事物的名词后缀) 的字面意思是‘发给古罗马士兵用来买盐的津贴或钱’。

senses.en: The sound someone makes when speaking or singing.
The right or opportunity to express opinions and influence decisions.
To express an opinion, feeling, or concern.

ex.en: Her gentle voice helped the frightened puppy settle down.
ex.zh: 她温柔的声音让受惊的小狗安静了下来。

ex.en: Public consultations give local residents a voice in decisions that directly affect their communities.
ex.zh: 公众咨询让当地居民有机会参与直接影响其社区的决策。

col: a voice in decisions｜决策中的发言权
tip: voice侧重人的嗓音；sound泛指声音。
ety: 从词源看，拉丁语 vox 的字面意思是‘声音与言语’。

senses.en: a male ruler who usually inherits his position

ex.en: The king waved to the crowd from his carriage.
ex.zh: 国王从马车上向人群挥手。

ex.en: In some countries, the king performs ceremonial duties while elected representatives make political decisions.
ex.zh: 在一些国家，国王履行礼仪职责，而民选代表作出政治决策。

col: the king's reign｜国王的统治时期
tip: king指男性君主；queen可指女王或王后。
ety: 从词源看，古英语 cyning 的字面意思是‘出身高贵血统并代表族群的领袖’。

senses.en: A way in which people or things are not alike
A disagreement between people or groups
The amount by which one quantity exceeds another

ex.en: The main difference between these jackets is their weight.
ex.zh: 这两件夹克的主要区别在于重量。

ex.en: Understanding cultural differences can help international students adapt more successfully to life in a new country.
ex.zh: 了解文化差异有助于留学生更顺利地适应新国家的生活。

tip: 比较两者用the difference between A and B。
ety: 从词源看，dis- (分离) + ferre (携带) 的字面意思是‘把事物向不同方向带开，使其呈现出分离的不同状态’。

senses.en: to want something to happen and believe it may happen
a feeling that something wanted may happen

ex.en: I hope the rain stops before our picnic.
ex.zh: 我希望野餐前雨能停。

ex.en: Many graduates hope to find meaningful employment that allows them to contribute positively to society.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生希望找到有意义的工作，使自己能够为社会作出积极贡献。

col: hope to do something｜希望做某事
hope for the best｜抱最好的希望
in the hope of｜怀着……的希望
tip: 可说hope to do，不说hope sb to do。
ety: 从词源看，古英语 hopian 的字面意思是‘在不确定中翘首以盼某个美好结果’。

senses.en: someone who leads people and explains places they visit
a book or resource giving useful information or instructions
to show someone the way or help them decide

ex.en: Our guide led us through the narrow market streets.
ex.zh: 导游带我们穿过市场里狭窄的街道。

ex.en: Teachers should guide students towards reliable sources rather than simply provide answers to every question.
ex.zh: 教师应引导学生寻找可靠的信息来源，而不是直接给出每个问题的答案。

col: guide someone through｜引导某人完成
guided tour｜有导游带领的游览
tip: 指南用a guide to；指导某人完成用guide someone through。
ety: 从词源看，源自古法语 guider 的字面意思是‘走在前面指示方向或看管路径’。

senses.en: a usually hard, shiny material that conducts heat and electricity

ex.en: The metal handle felt cold against my fingers.
ex.zh: 金属把手摸起来冰凉。

ex.en: Recycling metal reduces the demand for mining and can significantly lower energy consumption in manufacturing.
ex.zh: 回收金属可以减少采矿需求，并显著降低制造业的能源消耗。

tip: 泛指材料时不可数；指金属种类时可数。
ety: 从词源看，源自古希腊语 metallon 的字面意思是‘从地下矿井中开采出的闪光矿物’。

senses.en: a round, deep container used for food or liquids
to roll a bowling ball or deliver a cricket ball

ex.en: She warmed her hands around a bowl of soup.
ex.zh: 她双手捧着一碗汤取暖。

ex.en: Serving meals in smaller bowls may help people control portions and reduce unnecessary food waste.
ex.zh: 用较小的碗盛饭可能有助于人们控制食量，减少不必要的食物浪费。

tip: a bowl of表示“一碗”；bowling指保龄球运动。
ety: 从词源看，bolla 的字面意思是‘鼓起的、圆拱形的容器’。

senses.en: any day from Monday to Friday

ex.en: The swimming pool is quieter on weekday mornings.
ex.zh: 游泳池在工作日的早晨比较安静。

ex.en: Extending library opening hours on weekdays would benefit students who work during the day.
ex.zh: 延长图书馆工作日的开放时间，将有利于白天工作的学生。

tip: 指周一至周五，不保证当天实际上需要上班。
ety: week (周/星期) + day (日/天) 的字面意思是‘属于一周常规序列中的某一天’。

senses.en: To give someone something they need or make it available.
To support someone financially by supplying what they need.

ex.en: The campsite provides clean towels and blankets for every guest.
ex.zh: 营地为每位客人提供干净的毛巾和毯子。

ex.en: Local authorities should provide affordable public transport to ensure that all residents can access essential services.
ex.zh: 地方政府应提供价格可负担的公共交通，确保所有居民都能获得基本服务。

col: provide access to｜提供使用……的机会
provide someone with something｜向某人提供某物
tip: 用provide sb with sth或provide sth for sb。
ety: 从词源看，pro- (向前、提前) + videre (看)的字面意思是‘提前向前看，预见到未来的需求’。

senses.en: a large building or complex containing many shops

ex.en: We spent the rainy afternoon browsing in the mall.
ex.zh: 下雨的下午，我们一直在购物中心闲逛。

ex.en: A new shopping mall may create jobs, but it can also threaten small independent retailers.
ex.zh: 新的购物中心可能创造就业机会，但也可能威胁独立小零售商的生存。

tip: mall常用于美式英语；英式常说shopping centre。
ety: 从词源看，源自意大利语 pallamaglio（palla '球' + maglio '木槌'） 的字面意思是‘用木槌击球游戏的专用场地’。

senses.en: an entrance area or passage connecting rooms in a building
a large room or building used for public gatherings
a building where university students live

ex.en: Please leave your wet shoes in the hall.
ex.zh: 请把湿鞋留在门厅里。

ex.en: The community hall provides an affordable space where residents can attend classes and organise local events.
ex.zh: 社区会堂为居民提供了一个价格实惠的场所，供他们上课和组织当地活动。

col: halls of residence｜大学学生宿舍
tip: 英式英语中，大学宿舍常称halls或halls of residence。
ety: 从词源看，原始日耳曼语 *haljō（掩盖、庇护）的字面意思是‘被屋顶覆盖的庇护空间’。

senses.en: Making something easier to do or understand.
Willing to help other people.

ex.en: Your map was helpful when we explored the village.
ex.zh: 我们游览村庄时，你的地图帮了大忙。

ex.en: Clear feedback is particularly helpful for students who are learning to organise their ideas in academic essays.
ex.zh: 对于正在学习如何组织学术论文思路的学生来说，清晰的反馈尤其有帮助。

col: find something helpful｜觉得某物有帮助
tip: helpful可形容事物有用，也可形容人乐于助人。
ety: 从词源看，help + -ful 的字面意思是‘充满援助之力的’。

senses.en: A country in the northern part of Great Britain.

ex.en: We explored old castles during our holiday in Scotland.
ex.zh: 我们在苏格兰度假时游览了古老的城堡。

ex.en: Scotland attracts visitors with its dramatic landscapes, while rural communities benefit from spending on accommodation and local services.
ex.zh: 苏格兰以壮丽的风景吸引游客，而乡村社区则受益于游客在住宿和当地服务上的消费。

col: the west coast of Scotland｜苏格兰西海岸
a trip to Scotland｜苏格兰之旅
tip: 苏格兰是英国的组成部分；形容词通常用Scottish。

senses.en: An illness affecting humans, animals or plants

ex.en: The vet checked our rabbit for signs of disease.
ex.zh: 兽医检查了我们的兔子，看是否有患病迹象。

ex.en: Access to clean drinking water can significantly reduce the spread of infectious diseases in vulnerable communities.
ex.zh: 获得清洁饮用水可以显著减少传染病在脆弱社区中的传播。

col: the spread of disease｜疾病传播
tip: 重音在第二音节；泛指疾病可不加冠词。
ety: 从词源看，dis- (不，缺乏) + ease (舒适，安逸) 的字面意思是‘失去了舒适和安逸，处于不自在的状态’。

senses.en: A board displaying announcements for people to read.

ex.en: Someone pinned a lost cat poster to the noticeboard.
ex.zh: 有人把寻猫启事钉在了布告栏上。

ex.en: A shared noticeboard can help residents discover local events and participate more actively in community life.
ex.zh: 共用布告栏可以帮助居民了解当地活动，更积极地参与社区生活。

col: put up a noticeboard｜安装布告栏
tip: 英式常用noticeboard，美式常用bulletin board。

senses.en: to choose someone or something from available options
to remove fruit or flowers from a plant
a tool with a pointed metal head for breaking hard ground

ex.en: You can pick any colour for your new curtains.
ex.zh: 新窗帘的颜色你可以随便选。

ex.en: Schools should help students pick courses that match their interests rather than focus only on future earnings.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生选择符合兴趣的课程，而不是只关注未来收入。

tip: pick可指挑选或采摘；捡起通常用pick up。
ety: 严格按照“从词源看，源自古英语 pician 的字面意思是‘用尖锐工具去刺或戳’。”这样的句式，把 root_breakdown 和 literal_image 组织成一句完整、简洁的中文话术，作为速写小结，不展开完整历史故事

senses.en: A building or part of a building for keeping vehicles.
A business where vehicles are repaired and serviced.

ex.en: We keep our car and bicycles in the garage.
ex.zh: 我们把汽车和自行车停在车库里。

ex.en: Converting an unused garage into living space can provide additional accommodation without requiring new land.
ex.zh: 将闲置车库改成居住空间，可以在不占用新土地的情况下增加住房。

tip: 英式英语也常用 garage 指汽车修理厂。
ety: 源自法语 gare (保护、防御) 的字面意思是‘一个用于保护和安置车辆的建筑结构’。

senses.en: Help or useful work provided for people or customers.
Check and repair a vehicle or machine to keep it working.
A formal religious ceremony.

ex.en: The friendly service made us feel welcome at the café.
ex.zh: 咖啡馆里热情的服务让我们感到宾至如归。

ex.en: Reliable bus services allow residents without cars to reach hospitals, schools and workplaces.
ex.zh: 可靠的公交服务让没有汽车的居民也能到达医院、学校和工作地点。

tip: 表示服务质量常不可数；各项服务可用复数。
ety: 从词源看，servus 和 -ium 的字面意思是‘奴隶或仆人所履行的职责、效忠状态与劳务’。

senses.en: Someone who studies in the same class as you.

ex.en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
ex.zh: 上课前，我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。

ex.en: Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 与同班同学合作完成小组项目可以帮助学生培养沟通和解决问题的能力。

col: a former classmate｜以前的同班同学
help a classmate｜帮助同班同学
tip: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。
ety: class (班级、课堂) + mate (伙伴、同事) 的字面意思是‘在同一个课堂里一起学习的伙伴’。
